title: 10 December 2011: Paul McCartney live at Ericsson Globe Arena, Stockholm, Sweden
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Ericsson Globe in Stockholm, Sweden, on 10 December 2011.

It was the 15th show of the On The Run Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between July 2011 and November 2012.

There were minor setlist changes from his previous show at the O2 Arena in London. He opened with ‘Magical Mystery Tour’ instead of ‘Hello, Goodbye’, and played ‘Got To Get You Into My Life’ rather than ‘Drive My Car’.

‘I’m Looking Through You’ was played instead of ‘I’ve Just Seen A Face’, and ‘And I Love Her’ rather than ‘I Will’. ‘Nineteen Hundred And Eighty-Five’ and ‘Come And Get It’ were also swapped around in the set.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

This was McCartney’s first show in Sweden since the 04 Summer Tour stopped at the Ullevi Stadium in Gothenburg in 2004. McCartney had previously performed at the Globe Arena on 1 October 1993 and 4 and 5 May 2003.
